concerns.text: The Constitution Check table claims “All citations limited to the two verified datasets (Voices‑in‑the‑Wild‑2M, DNS‑Challenge – DNS noted as not verified)”. Citing DNS‑Challenge, which is explicitly marked as *not verified*, violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). Either remove the DNS‑Challenge citation or provide a verified source; the plan must not reference unverified external datasets.
